args.summary:
Model built successfully for a three-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box-girder bridge (30+40+30 m, deck 12.5 m, single-cell box, C50).

Idealization: 2D spine-beam model, continuous_on_piers (pier columns modelled), girder A=6.532 m², I=3.564 m⁴ (cast_box section integrated), Ec=34500 MPa (C50, JTG 3362-2018 Table 3.1.5), γ=26.0 kN/m³ (JTG D60-2015 4.2.1), w=169.83 kN/m, m=17.31 t/m (girder self-weight only).

Bearings (2 per line, laminated elastomeric, manufacturer Ge=1.2 MPa): Abutments 0 & 3 and Pier 1 = PTFE sliding (longitudinally free, Kh=0), Pier 2 = plain fixed (longitudinally spring, Kh=13.1 MN/m). Vertical stiffnesses Kv: 3.61 MN/m (abutments), 8.08 MN/m (Pier 1), 8.97 MN/m (Pier 2). Shape factors S = 10.10, 13.54, 14.69 respectively.

Piers: twin circular 1.6 m columns, C40 (Ec=32500 MPa), Pier 1 H=14 m, Pier 2 H=8 m; A=4.021 m², I=0.6434 m⁴ each.

Live load: Class I, one-way, 3 lanes → n_lanes=3, ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk = 320/340/320 kN per span.

Key results: first vertical bending frequency f1=3.434 Hz → impact factor μ=0.2023 (JTG D60-2015 4.3.2). Self-weight support reactions 1840/6646/6666/1832 kN. Self-weight midspan moments 8490/12616/8372 kNm and support moments −21233/−21469 kNm. Governing live-load moments: max positive 9701 kNm (mid-span 2), max negative −7558 kNm. All L1 topology, L2 code and L3 mechanics checks passed.
